name: Great Cockcrow Railway, Chertsey
summary: Ride behind miniature steam and diesel locomotives around an extensive outdoor railway, run by enthusiasts and open on selected dates in the main season, subject to weather and operational conditions.
reasonToVisit: A miniature steam and diesel railway run by enthusiasts, open on selected dates
planningDetail: Selected Sundays, usually May to October — check age rules and the day's service before travelling
